purpose: Freeze task, research questions, authority, and claim boundary.
required_tests: T001 closure and T002 registry audits
pass_criteria: Task and claim boundary explicit; closure evidence PASS.
fail_criteria: Authority/scope ambiguity or closure not PASS.
recovery_action: Stop downstream implementation and repair source/coverage evidence.

purpose: Freeze canonical hardware/data semantics and firmware schema.
required_tests: Schema fixtures; bench timing/ADC/packet verification
pass_criteria: All required fields, types, clocks, provenance, and verified/unknown semantics defined.
fail_criteria: Sensor semantics remain unknown without explicit evidence/status.
recovery_action: Bench hardware and inspect firmware/backend; version the contract.

purpose: Verify exact public dataset versions and immutable provenance.
required_tests: Checksum/license/parse smoke tests
pass_criteria: Exact declared versions download/parse with hashes and licenses.
fail_criteria: Missing, corrupt, or mis-versioned source.
recovery_action: Redownload or repair manifest; do not proceed on uncertain source.

purpose: Validate records, annotations, identifiers, and locked channel policy.
required_tests: Record/schema/channel/duplicate/symbol-census tests
pass_criteria: All expected fields and annotation/channel checks pass or documented version exception is approved.
fail_criteria: Unexpected fields/counts or untracked exclusions.
recovery_action: Block labels/splits; repair validation or source version.

purpose: Freeze AAMI_SVF_WINDOW_V1 and shared AAMI_SVF_MAP_V1.
required_tests: Complete allowlist/unknown/paced/non-beat/window eligibility tests
pass_criteria: Symbol mapping and target tests pass for both source datasets.
fail_criteria: Any ambiguous, inconsistent, or silently coerced target symbol.
recovery_action: Revise/version mapping before any training and regenerate dependent artifacts.

purpose: Freeze patient partitions before windows/models.
required_tests: Disjoint participants; 201/202 grouping; post-split window build audit
pass_criteria: Zero patient overlap; 201/202 grouped; patient counts reported.
fail_criteria: Any leakage, role violation, or result-driven regeneration.
recovery_action: Regenerate before training and invalidate all dependent runs.

purpose: Prove causal preprocessing, resampling, gaps, windows, and quality.
required_tests: Future-append; impulse; chunk equivalence; gap; window; hard-quality tests
pass_criteria: All future-append and chunk-equivalence tests pass; gap/window/quality contracts exact.
fail_criteria: Any future dependence, state mismatch, or gap/window contract defect.
recovery_action: Replace/version the transform and invalidate caches/downstream runs.

purpose: Establish pipeline sanity with locked trivial/classical baselines.
required_tests: Training-only majority and feature fit-scope tests
pass_criteria: Pipeline produces reproducible metrics and majority predictor is train-derived.
fail_criteria: Pipeline failure, leakage, or held-out prevalence selection.
recovery_action: Debug data/features/model without using test outcomes.

purpose: Freeze reproducible MODEL_V1 architecture/checkpoint/config.
required_tests: Shape; fixed-vector logits; seed/config/checkpoint determinism
pass_criteria: Validation acceptance and test-vector reproduction pass; checkpoint hash stored.
fail_criteria: Unstable model, interface drift, or unreproducible logits.
recovery_action: Simplify/tune only on train/validation, then version and re-gate.

purpose: Validate deterministic context, episode policy, and controlled quality-aware comparison.
required_tests: Synchronization; quality; state table; episode; deterministic perturbation tests
pass_criteria: Sync/quality/episode tests pass and controlled comparison reproduces without learned-fusion claim.
fail_criteria: False multimodal claim, undefined episode counting, or nondeterministic comparison.
recovery_action: Fix context/episode experiment; never invent predictive labels.

purpose: Freeze calibration, internal, noise, and external evidence without post-test tuning.
required_tests: Calibration provenance; clustered statistics; checkpoint/threshold/no-adaptation audits
pass_criteria: Checkpoint/threshold locked and evaluations use declared patient-level uncertainty.
fail_criteria: Any post-test tuning, window CI, lead/map drift, or external adaptation.
recovery_action: Version bump and new untouched-test policy; never overwrite prior evidence.

purpose: Validate analytical aggregation and frozen IID FedAvg baseline.
required_tests: Toy weighted mean; client disjointness; round/config audit
pass_criteria: Toy equivalence and stable locked-budget IID run pass.
fail_criteria: Aggregation/serialization/patient-contamination defect.
recovery_action: Block FL extensions; repair toy and client-manifest logic first.

purpose: Validate controlled heterogeneity with patient integrity and matched budgets.
required_tests: Client manifest and config-difference audit
pass_criteria: Patient integrity and declared matched-budget construction pass.
fail_criteria: Confounded clients, cross-site patients, or hidden budget changes.
recovery_action: Rebuild/version manifests and rerun affected experiments.

purpose: Freeze a matched FedAvg/FedProx comparison.
required_tests: mu=0 equivalence; config-match; paired statistic tests
pass_criteria: Only local objective differs and all comparison settings remain matched.
fail_criteria: Unmatched setting, failed mu=0 equivalence, or test-driven tuning.
recovery_action: Repair objective/config, retune only on federated validation, rerun.

purpose: Validate scoped SecAgg+ correctness, visibility, and overhead.
required_tests: Aggregate correctness; dropout; server-visible objects; claim audit
pass_criteria: Individual clear update is absent at server aggregation interface and limitations are explicit.
fail_criteria: Privacy claim unsupported or aggregate incorrect.
recovery_action: Fix reference workflow or remove implemented-privacy claim under fallback.

purpose: Measure mandatory gateway feasibility.
required_tests: Prediction equivalence and >=1000-window resource benchmark
pass_criteria: Model size, parameters, peak RAM, p50/p95 latency, and throughput measured.
fail_criteria: No deployable gateway artifact or unexplained prediction delta.
recovery_action: Retain research model on gateway Python; omit unsupported optimization.

purpose: Prove same canonical path accepts real synchronized hardware data.
required_tests: Contract, clock/sync, quality, dropout, latency, and replay tests
pass_criteria: Same contract/pipeline accepts consent-compliant wearable session with domain-only claims.
fail_criteria: Hidden separate pipeline, unverified semantics, or clinical efficacy claim.
recovery_action: Fix integration/contract or reduce claim; do not fabricate labels.

purpose: Validate EXPLAINABILITY_V1 diagnostics.
required_tests: Method parameter, case-selection, and completeness-delta tests
pass_criteria: Zero baseline, 64-step Gauss-Legendre, signed/absolute outputs, convergence and predeclared cases saved.
fail_criteria: Method/parameter drift, attractive-case selection, or causal clinical wording.
recovery_action: Fix implementation or omit unstable method from core UI.

purpose: Freeze versioned research-only runtime schema.
required_tests: Schema, status code, version fields, REST/WebSocket equivalence
pass_criteria: Versioned outputs/errors and research semantics pass.
fail_criteria: Schema drift, missing IDs, diagnosis string, or alternate stream logic.
recovery_action: Fix before dashboard integration.

purpose: Validate state mapping and safe wording.
required_tests: All-state mapping, required panels/metadata, prohibited-wording tests
pass_criteria: UI state wording exactly matches contract and exposes versions/domain.
fail_criteria: Diagnostic wording or state/schema mismatch.
recovery_action: Block release; fix strings/state consumption.

purpose: Prove clean supported-runtime recreation and artifact identity.
required_tests: Clean environment, lock, command, manifest, seed, and hash verification
pass_criteria: Smoke run reproduces artifact IDs/metrics within declared tolerance without manual dependency.
fail_criteria: Missing lock/config/seed/hash or manual reconstruction.
recovery_action: Lock environment and regenerate evidence through scripts.

purpose: Validate recorded stream through dashboard and evidence logs.
required_tests: Recorded wearable replay end-to-end and log/version assertions
pass_criteria: Recorded stream -> quality -> inference -> fusion -> API -> dashboard works continuously with logs.
fail_criteria: Integration failure, hidden manual step, or unsafe state.
recovery_action: Use documented fallback level and repair the failing boundary.

purpose: Freeze complete reproducible evidence package and defensible claims.
required_tests: Release manifest existence/hash/gate/limitation/claim audit
pass_criteria: All mandatory artifacts present and hashed; gate/fallback/limitations consistent.
fail_criteria: Missing evidence, silent gate skip, or unsupported claim.
recovery_action: Do not submit as complete; regenerate evidence or invoke explicit fallback.
